newsitem.title: USA: Daiichi begins U.S. phase I drug study.
newsitem.headline: Daiichi begins U.S. phase I drug study.

text.p: Daiichi Pharmaceutical Co Ltd said on Monday that it has started its U.S. phase I clinical trials for DX-8951f in cancer patients with solid tumors.
The drug is a topoisomerase I inhibitor, which interferes with the rescaling of genetic material after a cell divides, Daiichi said in a statement.

Phase I studies are being conducted at the MD Anderson Cancer Center in Houston, the Cancer Therapy and Research Center in San Antonio and New York's Memorial Sloan-Kettering Cancer Center, Daiichi said.
Daiichi said another trial was started at the Institut Gustave Soussy in France and further studies will be initiated in the Netherlands, England and Japan in the near future.
